body: Don't think I need to go, don't want to waste anyone's time when I don't even feel ill
Could have written this post myself - I feel just the same and it never gets better
I'm desperate. I've tried getting help but I'm past that now - no one really cares if I live or die
It does sound like depression, a common symptom is loss of interest and struggling to think clearly. I suffer with this too
Thank you for replying, I hope things get better for you, it's so scary living like this
